text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening thesis with three reasons","quality":"organization","description":"The essay lays out its claim and preview of reasons in a structured way that helps the argument feel planned."},{"evidence":"three body paragraphs on error, safety, and leisure","quality":"development","description":"The essay develops multiple supporting points instead of relying on a single idea."},{"evidence":"Google’s cars have driven more than half a million miles without a crash","quality":"use of evidence","description":"The essay quotes and applies a concrete detail from the article to support its position."},{"evidence":"explains how human error leads to accidents and how driverless cars reduce that risk","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay more fully connects evidence to the claim with cause-and-effect explanation."},{"evidence":"“In conclution… Hence…” closing","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends with a more complete wrap-up that restates the argument and its main points."}]}
